derivedParts.basis: Published PCB outline;1.6mm thickness is an explicit unmeasured placeholder. The unknown rear remains marked UNKNOWN. Photo appearance is not native CAD or electrical layout.

dimensionTargets.scope: Manufacturer nominal outline; component stack and1.6mm assumed thickness excluded.

sourceSearch.scope: Official Wiki resources, two schematics and144-member Pico source archive inspected; no board STEP/KiCad mechanical assembly found. Firmware/tool payloads are not CAD.

pcb-main.uncertainty: Manual source board-edge registration; component height, parallax and source image resampling are not calibrated.

materialBasis: Manufacturer reference photographs guide approximate colors. Materials and undocumented package finishes are visualization only.
assemblyNotes: Millimetres; source geometry is retained without scaling. Source revisions, omitted members and estimated reconstruction boundaries are explicit.
limitations: No hardware-fit or browser/WebGL acceptance is implied by the retained CAD or CPU geometry checks.
Factory display execution is independently recorded in product limitations; a model screen only shows the actual emulator framebuffer.
Partial photo-derived carrier.1.6mm PCB, component heights, USB connector envelope and pin lengths are explicit estimates; unknown reverse face remains labelled UNKNOWN.
Header SKUs use20pins/side with2.54mm pitch; header axial length and0.6mm section are approximate. No enclosure or cable mating claim.
Pico is a headless board; no screen inherited from the separate LCD SKU. RGB spatial output not implemented.
